title: Entity icon
responsibility: Draws a small decorative icon for a category or action.

inputs.name: Icon.name
inputs.description: It selects the SVG path when the icon renders; recognized keys are open, pages, apis, layouts, components, models, game, functions, configs, services, model, reasoning, settings, branch, commit, workbench, and deploy, while other strings use the pages path.

inputs.name: Icon.size
inputs.description: It sets the rendered SVG width and height; the component uses 22 when size is omitted and applies no additional range or unit validation.

outputs.name: Icon
outputs.description: It renders a decorative hx-svg with width and height from size, a 0 0 24 24 viewBox, and one hx-svg-path using the selected path data. It uses a 1.6 currentColor rounded stroke and aria-hidden=true; unknown names render the pages path.
